complexity_ledger.narrative: Workflow close of attribute-the-catch. The epic ships documentation and prompts: `references/bug_attribution.md` (the four record kinds -- CATCH, REACH, BLIND, PRICE), the two surfaces that ask for them at ticket close-out and workflow close, `prompts/regression_architecture.md`, and AT-04's clause-by-clause evaluation of six goals. MODEL DELTA IS ZERO AND THAT IS THE TICKET: no TLA+ action, variable or invariant was added, removed or changed, and `specs/current` was byte-identical to `specs/desired_program_model` on every semantic file at close. Six goals MET; one clause of GOAL-the-record-says-what-caught-it is DESIGNED, NOT APPLIED, because the 364-row ledger whose 27 out-of-vocabulary rows it would dispose lives on epic/stabilize-substrate and arrives with #296 -- stated in AT-04's RESULT.md as the epic's single largest limitation rather than worked around.
